<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Método Criação Infinita — Destrave sua criação de conteúdo</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#fff;--card:#fff;--tx:#0d0d0d;--mut:#5c5766;--ac:#8b5cf6;--ac2:#facc15;--bd:#ebe4fb;--dark:#0d0d0d;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0d0d0d;--card:#1a1a1f;--tx:#f7f4ff;--mut:#b5aec4;--bd:#2f2745;--dark:#000;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0d0d0d;--card:#1a1a1f;--tx:#f7f4ff;--mut:#b5aec4;--bd:#2f2745;--dark:#000;color-scheme:dark}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font:17px/1.6 "Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
.w{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
section{padding:56px 0}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 16px}
h1{font-size:clamp(34px,8vw,54px)}
h2{font-size:clamp(27px,6vw,38px);text-align:center}
.tag{display:inline-block;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bd);color:var(--ac);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:99px;margin-bottom:18px}
.hero{text-align:center;padding-top:40px}
.hero p{color:var(--mut);font-size:19px;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto 26px}
em{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(transparent 62%,rgba(250,204,21,.65) 0);}
.btn{display:block;background:var(--ac2);color:#0d0d0d;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;font-size:19px;text-align:center;padding:18px 26px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(250,204,21,.35);max-width:440px;margin:0 auto;transition:transform .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.sub{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;margin-top:12px}
.dor{background:var(--dark);color:#f4effa}
.dor h2{color:#fff}
.dor li{margin:10px 0;list-style:none;padding-left:30px;position:relative}
.dor li:before{content:"✕";position:absolute;left:0;color:#f87171;font-weight:800}
.dor ul{padding:0;max-width:560px;margin:24px auto}
.dor p{text-align:center}
.grid{display:grid;gap:16px;margin-top:28px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:18px;padding:24px}
.card .n{font-size:30px}
.card h3{font-size:22px;margin:6px 0 8px}
.card p{margin:0;color:var(--mut)}
.chk li{list-style:none;position:relative;padding:12px 0 12px 34px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)}
.chk{padding:0;margin:24px 0}
.chk li:before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;top:12px;color:var(--ac);font-weight:900}
.for{display:grid;gap:14px;margin-top:24px}
.about{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.av{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ac),var(--ac2));display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font:700 32px Georgia,serif;flex:none}
.offer{background:var(--dark);color:#fff;text-align:center}
.offer h2{color:#fff}
.box{background:var(--card);color:var(--tx);border-radius:22px;padding:30px 22px;max-width:480px;margin:26px auto 0;border:2px solid var(--ac)}
.box ul{text-align:left;padding:0;margin:0 0 20px}
.box li{list-style:none;padding:7px 0 7px 28px;position:relative;font-size:16px}
.box li:before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--ac);font-weight:900}
.de{color:var(--mut);text-decoration:line-through}
.price{font:800 50px Georgia,serif;color:var(--ac);line-height:1}
.price small{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
.gar{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
details{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 20px;margin:10px 0}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
details p{color:var(--mut);margin:10px 0 0}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;padding:30px 20px 100px}
.sticky{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:10px 16px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:var(--card);border-top:1px solid var(--bd);z-index:9;display:none}
.sticky .btn{padding:14px;font-size:17px}
@media(max-width:700px){.sticky{display:block}}
.hp{background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--ac2);border-radius:26px;max-width:340px;margin:34px auto 0;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(139,92,246,.25)}.hp img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}.pf{width:150px;height:auto;border-radius:20px;border:3px solid var(--ac2);flex:none}.gp{width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:4px solid var(--ac2);margin-bottom:14px}
</style>
</head>
<body>

</html>
